name: history-centered membrane events with imagewise temporal binding

source.strict_load_order: strict-load the untouched original S2NetCore before replacing only membrane_layer with HistoryBoundMembrane

history_event_membrane.event_forward: e_t = H(u_t - a_(t-1)); use registered act_fun_adp surrogate derivative
history_event_membrane.beta_parameters: one trainable scalar per component, initialized by logit(0.95)
history_event_membrane.closed_gate: only exact g_t == 0 preserves membrane and event-history state; no extra threshold
history_event_membrane.state_lifecycle: reset each core forward; detach values, not reset, at any truncated-rollout boundary
history_event_membrane.fold_order: S2NetCore B*4 rows are batch-major then component; beta index is folded_row mod 4

arms.history_event: event-driven recurrence; imagewise binder consumes actual emitted event traces
arms.gate_only: same event-driven recurrence; only binder input changes to captured continuous gate traces

classifier_restrictions: no temporal mean in place of the event trace
no theta, raw RGB, or gamma direct classifier input
prospective_binder.decoder_constraint: shared slot RGB decoder; reconstruct via the spike-derived assignment maps interpolated from 16x16 to native resolution and used as the slot-mixture weights
prospective_binder.forbidden: independent decoder mask/alpha output that can segment while ignoring spike assignments
prospective_binder.coordinates: decoder-only and identical in paired arms, if used

screen.next_gate: TRAIN-only 64-image activity/trace-variance/gradient-credit screen before a paired seed-1 256-update B16 pilot
measurements: finite nonzero actual gradient credit to beta/adaptation, membrane, and dendritic families
screen.thresholds: exactly four B16 batches per seed: each component aggregate binary-event occupancy in [0.02,0.98], and every image/component has at least 10% of units with both event values over the 512-frame band; any failure closes the recipe without tuning
screen.gradient_guard: history_event arm requires finite nonzero reconstruction credit to P, every beta component, tau_m, and dendritic parameters in every batch; gate_only records but does not fail on expected zero beta/membrane/dendritic credit because its binder input is upstream continuous gate

known_context.SW0125: late-rollout analytic RGB pilot completed but failed its registered FG-ARI gate
known_context.claim_limit: SW0126 is a distinct prospective mechanism hypothesis; it does not establish that gating, data scale, or truncated credit caused SW0125 failure
known_context.history_centering_risk: u-a can remove useful absolute membrane-level/object-amplitude information; an activity or gradient pass is not evidence of segmentation value
known_context.fixed_source_invariants: with the registered frozen source and pulse coupling disabled, theta/carrier/gate should remain unchanged; dendritic, membrane, and event traces may change because dendrites consume previous emitted spikes
